device.model: HD-XS2 (Globo) / Blue XS65 (Opticum): one software pack for both
device.soc: ALi M3503 (the bootloader chunk's version "M3503---0.1.0"; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build with the chip's internal NIM_S3503 demodulator driver)
device.family: M3503 (chips/m3503.py: the M36xx family with the chip ID 0x3503 and the XIP bootloader's cache-as-RAM stack)
device.demod: internal (NIM_S3503_0 / NIM_S3503_1; the NIM_S3501 driver is in the build too)

image.version: 1.3.5 "Reta_pol" (the Polish retail build: main-code chunk 112003000202162, version 00000135, "POL_NETR_PVR"; Libcore 13.8.0@SDK4.0fa.13.8_20150326, Application 1.0.0@SDK4.0fa.13.8_20150326; the SEE's uLibcore 1.1.5a@SDK_20111126)
image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (M3503---0.1.0), HDCPKey 0x02EE00 (00000001), MemCfg 0x02F000 (00000001), maincode 0x030000 (chunk "112003000202162" 00000135, LZMA 0x193357 bytes -> 7.0 MB), seecode 0x1D0000 (00000135, LZMA 0xDFFBA -> 3.0 MB), storage_part 0x2B0000, Radioback 0x2D0000 (1.0.0), ca 0x2DFF80, defaultdb 0x2F0000 (1.1.0), userdb 0x2FFF80 (1.0.0, 0x100070 bytes) -- the whole 4 MB flash

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)
source.note: The manufacturer's software pack Sw_Opticum_Blue_XS65_Globo_HD-XS2_SoftwarePack_1.3.5_2015-06-22.zip (two .abs images and a Polish README: unpack to the USB stick's root, the receiver picks the matching file itself); fetched 2026-10-11 from the mirror's Opticum / INNE folder.

simulator.note: As the M3503 family (2026-10-12), like the SmartHD image (run_dump_hdxs2_app_starts.py): the bootloader runs from the flash window with its cache-as-RAM stack, starts the SEE through its boot code at 0xA1016804 and the application, which starts the SEE's program at 0x86000200 on the second core (see.SeeCore): 77 calls answered and 34 of the SEE's by ~76 M instructions, no GE command yet; a silent build, one 0x01 byte to the UART.

desc: The official 1.3.5 "Reta_pol" update of the Globo HD-XS2 / Opticum Blue XS65 satellite receiver (main code 112003000202162, 2015-06-22): the Polish retail build of the SmartHD image next to it, with network OTA (ota.globo-multimedia.com:8443, wake-up timers for OTA and recordings) and Polish debug texts; its update file names are /c/Sw_Globo_HD-XS2_Reta_pol.abs and /c/XS2_Reta_pol.abs.

The same layout, bootloader (M3503---0.1.0), SEE program and drivers (PAN_FD650K, HDMI_ALI_E_150303_1, NIM_S3503 / NIM_S3501) as Sw_Globo_HD-XS2_SmartHD_1.3.5_2015-05-08.abs; the main code is a third bigger.
